description: Image Studio project memory: print the .image-studio brief at session start; at stop, block a completion claim. Both exit 0 when python3, the script, or a project store is missing.

hooks.command: S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/image-verify/scripts/studio_state.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$S" ]; then python3 "$S" hook session-start 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
S="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/image-verify/scripts/studio_state.py"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$S" ]; then python3 "$S" hook stop 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0
